name: create-booking
serverRules: Validate origin and destination stop order for the selected trip.
Check seat availability transactionally for the complete travel segment.
Reject the request when a seat overlaps an existing confirmed or active hold.
Calculate the total on the server; never trust a client-provided total.
Release an expired hold before evaluating availability.
